import { type JSXChildren } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { StructuredListContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type NativeContract } from '../../internal/catalog';

    title?: string;
    onToolbarAction?: (detail: {
        id: string;

}> & {
    itemActionsById?: Readonly<Record<string, JSXChildren>>;
    pagination?: JSXChildren;
};
export declare const StructuredList: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<StructuredListProps>;
